svg.title: A bolt replaced by a coupling
svg.desc: Left: a section through a bolted joint: two hatched plates of equal thickness clamped by a bolt with a hex head and washer on top, a shank through the clearance hole, threaded below the joint, and a washer and nut below. Right: the model: the upper plate alone on a fixed base, the bolt removed, and a reference point on the bolt's axis, at the height of the top face, joined by legs to the ring of the top face under the washer, with the bolt's force on the point.
